title: Lead software Engineer - Bluetooth
description:
**Job Title / Role:**
Lead software Engineer (Software)

Location: Ecity / Hosur

ExP:6 to 12

Job Purpose

The Lead Software Engineer will be responsible for driving the architecture, design, development, and delivery of Bluetooth and connected infotainment software solutions for current and next-generation TVS Motor connected vehicle platforms. The role requires strong technical expertise in Bluetooth technologies, embedded software development, and modern C++ programming, combined with proven leadership capabilities to guide a team of engineers in delivering high-quality, scalable, and secure software products.

The candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams including system architects, product management, mobile application teams, validation teams, and external technology partners to define and execute the roadmap for connected infotainment units across TVS Motor product lines. The role also involves mentoring engineers, driving technical excellence, and ensuring successful execution of software programs aligned with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead a software development team in the design, development, integration, and maintenance of Bluetooth application for connected infotainment systems based on Linux and Android platforms.

· Lead a software development team in the design, development, integration, and maintenance of Smartwatch application based on android and iOS platforms.

· Define and drive the technical roadmap for current and future connected infotainment systems, ensuring alignment with product strategy, customer requirements, and emerging industry trends.

· Architecture design and develop of robust software components using Modern C++ (C++14/C++17 and above) and C for embedded system applications.

· Own the design and implementation of Bluetooth features including device management, pairing/bonding, profile integration, connectivity management, protocol handling, performance optimization, and troubleshooting.

· Work closely with system architects and product teams to translate business requirements into scalable software architectures and technical solutions.

· Drive software quality through code reviews, design reviews, static analysis, unit testing, integration testing, and adherence to software engineering best practices.

· Mentor and technically guide team members, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

· Coordinate with validation, integration, and partner teams to ensure seamless software integration across vehicle, mobile, and cloud ecosystems.

· Analyze complex field and customer issues, drive root-cause analysis, and implement effective corrective actions.

· Contribute to technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and strategic decisions related to infotainment, connectivity, Bluetooth, mobile integration, and software platform evolution.

· Participate in release planning, risk assessment, effort estimation, and project execution to ensure on-time delivery of program milestones.

· Collaborate with Android, iOS, and cloud application teams to enable end-to-end connected experiences and feature enhancements.

· Stay current with advancements in Bluetooth standards, connected vehicle technologies, infotainment systems, mobile ecosystems, and automotive software development practices.

· Product Precertification, Certification in BT SIG and ensuring product compliance with regulatory bodies.

· Evaluating right Bluetooth ICs, Sourcing, defining strategy for the upcoming products.

Education

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or related discipline.

Experience

**Required Qualification:**

· Prior experience in connectivity domain including Automotive Infotainment, Connected Vehicle, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay.

· 6 to 12 years of software development experience with strong expertise in C++14/C++17 and solid programming experience in C, Java, Kotlin, KMP. Knowing scripting is a plus.

· Minimum 4 years of experience leading or mentoring a software engineering team.

· Prior experience in Linux Platform development, Android platform development, and mobile application integration. Good understanding of android and iOS application development. Understanding of Linux, Andoid and iOS OS concepts.

· Experience with communication protocols, wireless technologies, and connected device ecosystems. Strong understanding of Bluetooth architecture, protocols, profiles, debugging using HCI and OTA logs. Wifi, NFC experience is a plus.

· Experience working with embedded systems and software development on bare metal and RTOS environments like FreeRTOS, Zephyr RTOS.

· Proven experience in software architecture, design patterns, debugging, performance optimization, and system-level problem solving.

· Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and CI/CD practices.

· Experience collaborating with global technology partners, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams.

· Understanding of cybersecurity, secure communications, and software update mechanisms in connected products.

· Work experience in Certifying and Listing in BT SIG.

Internal and External Interactions

· Internal - Cross functional teams and departments.

· External - Semiconductor suppliers, BT Stack Suppliers.

title: Teamcenter Developer
description:
**Company Description**
Thinkinnov Solution Technologies Private Limited delivers innovative Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions built on a strong foundation of best practices, domain expertise, and technical knowledge. Drawing on over a decade of experience across multiple industries, the company designs scalable PLM implementations that help organizations achieve their long-term strategic objectives. The team specializes in setting up PLM processes for mass production, make-to-order, and engineer-to-order environments, covering the full project lifecycle from strategic consulting to sustaining services. With a focus on on-time, high-quality delivery, Thinkinnov Solution’s motivated and expert professionals tackle complex challenges and provide practical, results-oriented solutions for customers.
  
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role for a Teamcenter Developer. The Teamcenter Developer will configure, customize, and maintain Siemens Teamcenter PLM environments, including user roles, workflows, and data models to support engineering and manufacturing processes. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and optimize PLM usage for mass production, job shop, make-to-order, and engineer-to-order operations. The individual will create and maintain documentation, provide user training and support, and ensure adherence to PLM best practices and company standards. Daily responsibilities also include participating in implementation and upgrade projects, testing new functionalities, and coordinating with stakeholders to improve system performance and data integrity.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong PLM skills, including experience with Siemens Teamcenter configuration, customization, workflow management, and data modeling.
* Candidates should possess business process skills related to engineering change management, product data management, BOM management, and lifecycle processes in manufacturing or engineering organizations.
* Candidates should possess analytical and problem-solving skills, including requirements gathering, issue diagnostics, root-cause analysis, and performance optimization within PLM environments.
* Candidates should possess collaboration and communication skills to work with engineers, project managers, and IT teams, including clear documentation practices and user training capabilities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred, along with prior experience in PLM implementation or support.
* Familiarity with discrete manufacturing, job shop, make-to-order, or ETO environments and prior exposure to end-to-end PLM project phases is beneficial.

title: Network Automation Solution Developer
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Network Automation Solution Developer, you will validate Service Portals and ensure their reliability for leading telecom operators. Working with agile, cross\-functional teams, you will develop and execute test strategies for orchestration, automation, and service assurance across IP/MPLS networks. You will leverage test automation tools, troubleshoot issues, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to continuous integration and delivery, helping deliver high\-quality network automation solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and implement comprehensive end\-to\-end test strategies for Service Portals, focusing on performance and reliability.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Robot Framework for regression, functional, and system testing.
* Validate complex IP/MPLS network topologies, ensuring thorough testing of orchestration and automation functionalities.
* Troubleshoot issues, conduct root cause analysis, and collaborate with developers to drive continuous improvement.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines by integrating automated testing within the release process.
* Review and assess product requirements and design documents to ensure they meet testability standards.
* Mentor junior QA engineers, providing guidance and participating in peer reviews to enhance team skills.
* Report on quality metrics, defect tracking, and performance validation to ensure high\-quality product releases.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Telecommunications, IP Networking, or related field
* 10 years of experience in software quality assurance, with at least 2 years in the telecom/networking domain.
* Proficiency in Robot Framework, Python/Java scripting, and test automation design patterns
* Strong understanding of IP and network virtualization concepts.


**It would be nice if you also had:**
* Familiarity with Nokia NSP architecture and service provisioning (e.g., L3VPN, TE tunnels)
* Experience with Linux\-based environments, network emulators (e.g., IXIA, Spirent), and protocol analyzers (e.g., Wireshark)
* Excellent analytical, debugging, and documentation skills.
